case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised the hotel's scenery, ocean views, convenient location, breakfast/restaurant and, in some reports, friendly staff and clean, comfortable rooms. Multiple reviews mentioned the wellness area/jacuzzi or top-floor facilities being closed or not working. Other comments included mixed staff interactions (some kind, one report of reception attitude and delayed check‑in), a cleanliness complaint, limited toiletries, lack of food at a late arrival, and one guest noting poor weather.

review_summary_metadata.summary_method: Neutral LLM summary of the frozen recent review sample; no additional reviews retrieved.

priorities.recommendation: Run immediate refresher training for front-desk staff on service standards.
Conduct an immediate technical inspection of the wellness area and top-floor facilities to diagnose faults.
Perform an immediate housekeeping audit (spot checks) of recently departed rooms and common areas.
Inspect the jacuzzi and associated wellness equipment to confirm functionality and identify required maintenance.

priorities.area: Staff and service (front desk communication & attitude)
priorities.recommendation: Review front-desk check-in procedures and service recovery expectations, focusing on communication and delay handling.
Audit housekeeping checklists and toiletries replenishment policy and their execution.
